Prep time: 10 minutes Cook time: 30 minutes Total time: 40 minutes Number of Servings: 8 Ingredients 1/2 cup chopped onion 1/2 cup chopped bell pepper (any color) 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder or 1 clove garlic, minced 1 teaspoon oil 1/2 cup dried lentils, rinsed 4 1/2 teaspoons chili powder 1 teaspoon ground cumin 1/2 teaspoon dried cilantro or oregano (optional) 1 1/4 cups broth, any flavor Directions In a large skillet, sauté the onion, bell pepper and garlic in oil until tender, about 3 minutes. Add the lentils, chili powder, cumin and cilantro/oregano (if using). Cook and stir for 1 minute. Add broth. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer until the lentils are tender, 20 to 30 minutes for brown lentils, Add water if necessary to keep the lentils just covered with liquid. Uncover; cook until mixture thickens and most of the water is gone, 5 to 10 minutes. Use for tacos, wraps or salad. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.
